entities.summary: Hans-Jürgen "Hansi" Gnad is a retired German professional basketball player and coach. He is currently working as an assistant coach of the Bayer Giants Leverkusen of the ProA. .He represented the senior German national basketball team, and played in the German League team Bayer Giants Leverkusen.
